name: Shiomi Keiichiro
source:
Born on October 28, 1989. Scorpio. Blood type is B. Member of the Boxing Club. His hobbies are philosophy and literature.
Although he is quiet and abrasive, he enjoys reading books on philosophy and literature, and has excellent grades. He is often by his lonesome as he doesn't have much interest in others, but he is close with his childhood friends, Nakajima Hikaru and [url=/c136069]Ibuki Ginpei[/url], and sometimes they are seen together. Alongside Keiichiro, he formed the legendary calvary team with [url=/c136006]Taira Mitsuo[/url]. He often shows that he has special feelings towards [url=/c129118]Hirosawa Rinko[/url], the English teacher.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
